```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

source("../../config/paths.R")

experiment_name <- "gt_100taxa_high_signal"
beast_run_name <- "dynamic_sequence_gt"

paths <- make_run_paths(experiment_name)

sim_data_path <- file.path(
  paths$sim_data_dir,
  paste0(experiment_name, "_sim_data.rds")
)

beast_output_dir <- paths$beast_output_dir
validation_dir <- paths$validation_dir
```


# Purpose

For each exported dynamic snapshot, this reconstructs the exact Gaussian conditional:

p(beta, u | y, tree_t, v_phylo_t, v_resid_t)

and compares the sampled BEAST state to that conditional.


This can take a while (>1 hr for 235 snapshots), so I suggest only run when something genuinely changed in the tree inference - otherwise set rerun_snapshot_conditional to FALSE and load saved rds instead.

```{r rerun}
rerun_snapshot_conditional <- FALSE
```

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
library(Matrix)
library(ape)

if (!file.exists(sim_data_path)) {
  stop("Simulation data not found. Run 01_simulate_data.Rmd first: ", sim_data_path)
}

sim_data <- readRDS(sim_data_path)
y <- sim_data$y

list_snapshot_ids <- function(beast_output_dir, prefix_regex = "snapshot") {
  state_files <- list.files(
    beast_output_dir,
    pattern = "_state[.]csv$",
    full.names = FALSE
  )

  ids <- sub("_state[.]csv$", "", state_files)
  ids[grepl(prefix_regex, ids)]
}

read_snapshot <- function(snapshot_id, beast_output_dir) {
  snapshot_prefix <- file.path(beast_output_dir, snapshot_id)

  list(
    tree_edges = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_tree_edges.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    ),
    precision = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_precision_triplets.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    ),
    state = read.csv(
      paste0(snapshot_prefix, "_state.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      na.strings = ""
    )
  )
}

truthy <- function(x) {
  tolower(as.character(x)) == "true"
}

conditional_gaussian_validate_snapshot <- function(
    snapshot_id,
    beast_output_dir,
    y,
    prior_beta_mean = 0,
    prior_beta_variance = 1000
) {

  snapshot <- read_snapshot(snapshot_id, beast_output_dir)

  tree_edges_snapshot <- snapshot$tree_edges
  precision_snapshot <- snapshot$precision
  state_snapshot <- snapshot$state

  n_nodes <- nrow(tree_edges_snapshot)

  root_node_nr <- unique(state_snapshot$root_node_nr)
  stopifnot(length(root_node_nr) == 1)

  Q_full <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = precision_snapshot$row_node_nr + 1,
    j = precision_snapshot$col_node_nr + 1,
    x = precision_snapshot$value,
    dims = c(n_nodes, n_nodes)
  )

  latent_node_nrs <- setdiff(0:(n_nodes - 1), root_node_nr)
  latent_theta_indices <- seq_along(latent_node_nrs) + 1
  names(latent_theta_indices) <- latent_node_nrs

  Q_latent <- Q_full[latent_node_nrs + 1, latent_node_nrs + 1, drop = FALSE]

  is_leaf <- truthy(tree_edges_snapshot$is_leaf)
  tip_rows <- tree_edges_snapshot[is_leaf, ]

  brownian_variance <- unique(state_snapshot$brownian_variance)
  residual_variance <- unique(state_snapshot$residual_variance)
  beta <- unique(state_snapshot$beta)

  stopifnot(length(brownian_variance) == 1)
  stopifnot(length(residual_variance) == 1)
  stopifnot(length(beta) == 1)

  theta_count <- 1 + length(latent_node_nrs)

  C <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = theta_count, ncol = theta_count, sparse = TRUE)
  rhs <- numeric(theta_count)

  C[1, 1] <- 1 / prior_beta_variance
  rhs[1] <- prior_beta_mean / prior_beta_variance

  residual_precision <- 1 / residual_variance

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tip_rows))) {

    node_nr <- tip_rows$node_nr[i]
    node_id <- tip_rows$node_id[i]

    if (!node_id %in% names(y)) {
      stop("No y value found for tip ", node_id)
    }

    theta_index <- latent_theta_indices[as.character(node_nr)]

    observed <- as.numeric(y[node_id])

    C[1, 1] <- C[1, 1] + residual_precision
    C[1, theta_index] <- C[1, theta_index] + residual_precision
    C[theta_index, 1] <- C[theta_index, 1] + residual_precision
    C[theta_index, theta_index] <- C[theta_index, theta_index] + residual_precision

    rhs[1] <- rhs[1] + residual_precision * observed
    rhs[theta_index] <- rhs[theta_index] + residual_precision * observed
  }

  C[2:theta_count, 2:theta_count] <-
    C[2:theta_count, 2:theta_count] + Q_latent / brownian_variance

  C_dense <- as.matrix(C)
  posterior_mean <- as.numeric(solve(C_dense, rhs))
  posterior_covariance <- solve(C_dense)

  state_ordered <- state_snapshot[order(state_snapshot$node_nr), ]

  sampled_theta <- numeric(theta_count)
  sampled_theta[1] <- beta
  sampled_theta[2:theta_count] <- state_ordered$generation_time[
    match(latent_node_nrs, state_ordered$node_nr)
  ]

  difference <- sampled_theta - posterior_mean

  mahalanobis2 <- as.numeric(t(difference) %*% C_dense %*% difference)
  df <- length(sampled_theta)

  data.frame(
    snapshot_id = snapshot_id,
    beta = beta,
    brownian_variance = brownian_variance,
    residual_variance = residual_variance,
    df = df,
    mahalanobis2 = mahalanobis2,
    mahalanobis2_per_df = mahalanobis2 / df,
    chi_square_p_lower = pchisq(mahalanobis2, df = df)
  )
}
```

# Run validation

```{r run-validation}

if (rerun_snapshot_conditional) {

  snapshot_ids <- list_snapshot_ids(beast_output_dir)
  
  if (length(snapshot_ids) == 0) {
    stop("No snapshot files found in ", beast_output_dir)
  }
  
  snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      snapshot_ids,
      conditional_gaussian_validate_snapshot,
      beast_output_dir = beast_output_dir,
      y = y,
      prior_beta_mean = sim_data$prior$beta_mean,
      prior_beta_variance = sim_data$prior$beta_variance
    )
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results,
    file.path(
      validation_dir,
      paste0("dynamic_conditional_gaussian_results_", beast_run_name, ".rds")
    )
  )

} else {
  
  snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results <- readRDS(
    file.path(
      validation_dir,
      paste0("dynamic_conditional_gaussian_results_", beast_run_name, ".rds")
    )
)
  
}

snapshot_conditional_gaussian_summary <- data.frame(
  n_snapshots = nrow(snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results),
  mean_mahalanobis2_per_df = mean(snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results$mahalanobis2_per_df),
  median_mahalanobis2_per_df = median(snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results$mahalanobis2_per_df),
  min_mahalanobis2_per_df = min(snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results$mahalanobis2_per_df),
  max_mahalanobis2_per_df = max(snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results$mahalanobis2_per_df)
)

snapshot_conditional_gaussian_results
snapshot_conditional_gaussian_summary
```

Interpretation:

This validation reconstructs the exact conditional Gaussian distribution:

p(beta, u | y, tree_t, v_phylo_t, v_resid_t)

for each exported dynamic-tree snapshot and compares the BEAST sampled state against that conditional distribution. The main diagnostic is:

- `mahalanobis2_per_df` 

which measures overall multivariate deviation from the exact conditional Gaussian expectation.

Under a perfectly matched conditional Gaussian, we would expect it to be near 1, whereas values substantially above 1 suggest overdispersion relative to the exact conditional Gaussian.

If overdispersion is observed, potential causes are:
- incorrect Gibbs conditional updates,
- state-sync/store-restore inconsistencies,
- operator-coupling effects between tree proposals and Gibbs updates,
- dynamic-tree mixing effects during topology/branch-length proposals.

This validation alone cannot distinguish between problems intrinsic to the Gibbs sampler, and problems caused by interaction with the changing-tree MCMC machinery. Do frozen-tree validation (`07_generate_frozen_tree_xml.Rmd` and then `08_validate_frozen_tree_conditional_gaussian.Rmd`) to separate.
